description: This file defines a migration class for version 5.4.0 of the OrangeHRM system, setting up database schema changes, inserting default modules, language strings, API permissions, and configuration values related to authentication, OAuth2, and other system components.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Migration class for applying database schema updates for system version 5.4.0, including table creation, data insertion, and configuration updates.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration steps which include language string updates, module inserting, password policy settings, API permissions, schema modifications, and OAuth2 table creation.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string '5.4.0' associated with this migration.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Updates the language string version in the database to the specified version.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Provides an instance of LangStringHelper, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: modifyDefaultRequiredPasswordStrength
methods.description: Adjusts the default required password strength based on existing configuration, then deletes the old config key.

methods.name: modifyDefaultPasswordEnforcement
methods.description: Sets enforcement policies for password complexity and deletes the old configuration key.

methods.name: createOAuth2Tables
methods.description: Creates OAuth2-related tables for clients, authorization codes, access tokens, and refresh tokens, including default entries and encryption keys.

methods.name: changePermissionForAttendanceConfigurationAPI
methods.description: Adds permissions for attendance configuration API data group.

methods.name: changePermissionForTimeConfigPeriodAPI
methods.description: Adds permissions for time sheet configuration API data group.

methods.name: changePermissionForEmployeeWorkShiftAPI
methods.description: Adds permissions for employee work shift API data group.
